scope: Read-only native executable JAR inspection in memory; no scanner, Docker, Maven build, dependency modification or file extraction.
caveat: Native metadata compared to CI image report by nested path only. Exact equality with the CI image JAR bytes has NOT been established by this diagnostic; CI must bind SBOM hashes to the built image.
conclusions: Absent package records are observed; a zero vulnerability count for detected packages cannot establish complete JAR inventory coverage.

Missing pom.properties and noncanonical manifest titles/vendors can require Java DB lookup according to the pinned Trivy parser; Java DB absence for these hashes is a hypothesis, not verified by this diagnostic.
A Maven CycloneDX JSON SBOM provides explicit GAV/PURL identifiers. Verify Trivy ingests every required GAV and compare component hashes against every runtime nested JAR in the exact CI image.
Inventory completeness and advisory database coverage are separate. No claim of absence of every vulnerability is made.

The jarmode-tools JAR is added by Spring Boot repackage and matches the embedded resource in spring-boot-loader-tools byte for byte; a dependency-only Maven SBOM may omit it unless handled explicitly.
